gameDescriptionHtml:
A brutal Action RPG in pure Sword & Sorcery style. Lead King Xodan and the Oracle Queen Yanah in their desperate quest to save their people and free their daughter Sharyn from Zordax the Inhuman. Live an epic Sword & Sorcery tale inspired by the fantasy classics of the 1980s.

Game Features

  • A SAVAGE PREHISTORIC WORLD TO DISCOVER – An ancient lost land called Atlan, full of legends, mysteries, prehistoric beasts, nightmarish creatures and dangers of all kinds, populated by civilizations with ancient customs and unique mythology.
  • REFINED AND BRUTAL COMBAT MECHANICS – The art of combat involves dodges, parries, blocks, attacks of various types, counterattacks, rolls, unbalances, special powers, and blood-filled fatalities.
  • LOOT ARMOR, WEAPONS AND SHINING TREASURES – The ancient dungeons of Atlan conceal numerous treasures, including powerful weapons, shields, armor, helmets, rings, and so on, which increase your combat efficiency.
  • OLD-SCHOOL RPG AND DUNGEON CRAWLER – Age of Barbarians Chronicles is drenched in old-school spirit, from its RPG system, based on the tabletop game of the same name, to its Sword & Sorcery setting and classic dungeon-crawling exploration.
  • BARBARIC COOPERATIVE ACTION – Join forces with a friend and plunge into the savage world of Atlan. Explore deadly dungeons, uncover ancient treasures, and battle together to survive the campaign.
  • SAVE COMPANIONS AND LET THEM HELP YOU – A party of adventurers is stronger than one hero alone. However, remember that both treasure and experience points are shared among companions.
  • HANDCRAFTED AND PROCEDURAL DUNGEONS – Many dungeons are carefully hand-designed, but at the same time, you will encounter many others that are procedural, offering you countless combinations and making each exploration unique and rewarding.
